title: Juicy Savory British Pork Pie
description: A traditional British dish featuring tender pork and flaky puff pastry, this pie is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in. The combination of lardons and spices creates a rich and adventurous flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the lardons over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the chopped onion and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced pork shoulder to the skillet and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Stir in the chopped sage, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the pork mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg and fold the other half of the pastry over the filling.
Press the edges of the pastry together to seal the pie and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Place the pie on a baking sheet and brush the top with the remaining egg.
Bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
